Four hours. You walk out with a working **AI assistant you set up yourself** — plus
**2–3 automations** running on your own academic work. Not a search engine; a member of
your team that drafts, summarizes, and calculates.

**Hands-on tool:** Claude Cowork. **No coding** — you describe steps in plain language.
Concepts stay portable to ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and NotebookLM.

## The Delivery Loop

**Show** (instructor demo) → **Build** (you apply it to a real task) → **Refine** (quick
group critique). Aim for ~70% hands-on.

## Two Rules We Never Break

- **Newspaper Test** — guards what you *paste in*. Sanitize student data, unpublished
  research, and exam content before it goes anywhere.
- **The Undo Test** *(blast radius)* — guards what the agent *does*. Start every Skill and
  scheduled job in **draft / notify-me** mode before letting it act on its own.

All hands-on agent work runs in a **sandbox folder with dummy data**.
